items.name: confirm-button
items.title: Confirm Button
items.description: A Button that confirms on a click, a second click or a press and hold. Supports inline undo and a pending state for an async onConfirm.

items.name: confirm-menu-item
items.title: Confirm Menu Item
items.description: A DropdownMenu or ContextMenu item that confirms on a click, a second click or a press and hold. The menu stays open while the item is armed, held, pending or showing Undo, and closes once the action commits.

items.name: confirm-switch
items.title: Confirm Switch
items.description: A Switch that moves right away and can be taken back: flipping it again during the undo window undoes it, and onConfirm(checked) runs when the window ends.

items.name: type-to-confirm
items.title: Type to Confirm
items.description: An inline form that calls onConfirm only after the exact phrase is typed and every acknowledgement is checked. Supports inline undo and a pending state for an async onConfirm.

items.name: bulk-confirm
items.title: Bulk Confirm
items.description: A confirm for acting on many items at once that gets harder as the count grows: undo for a few, a second click for dozens, and typing the count for hundreds.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: An alert dialog with a ConfirmButton or TypeToConfirm as its confirm action, which closes only after an async onConfirm settles. Includes useConfirm, which returns an awaitable confirm() and a dialog element you render yourself.

items.name: confirm-popover
items.title: Confirm Popover
items.description: A popover anchored to any trigger, with one line about the consequence and a ConfirmButton, for actions that need a sentence but not a dialog. It stays open while an async onConfirm is pending.

items.name: consequences
items.title: Consequences
items.description: A list of what a confirmation will remove, with counts and names that collapse to "and N more". Pass it to TypeToConfirm or ConfirmDialog through their consequences prop.

items.name: undo-toast
items.title: Undo Toast
items.description: undoToast(message) shows a Sonner toast with an Undo button. It resolves true when the toast closes and false if Undo is clicked, so run the action only on true.
items.docs: Needs the shadcn <Toaster /> in your root layout.

items.name: undoable
items.title: Undoable
items.description: Wraps a list item or table row. Removing it collapses the row in place to a label and an Undo button at the same height, then runs onConfirm when the undo window ends.

items.name: unsaved-changes
items.title: Unsaved Changes
items.description: useUnsavedChanges asks before unsaved changes are lost: the browser's prompt on reload or close, an awaitable confirmLeave() for leaving a page, and Keep editing, Discard changes and an optional Save in a Dialog, Sheet or Drawer's footer before it closes.

items.name: tool-approval
items.title: Tool Approval
items.description: Approve or deny an AI SDK tool call, or a batch of them, with a gesture that matches its risk: undo for low, click again for medium, hold for high and a typed phrase for critical. Pass addToolApprovalResponse from useChat as onRespond.

items.name: danger-zone-01
items.title: Danger Zone
items.description: A project settings danger zone: pause deployments with an undo window, transfer the project in a dialog, and delete it in a dialog that asks for the project name.

items.name: api-keys-01
items.title: API Keys
items.description: A list of API keys with the last time each was used, hold to revoke, and a Create key dialog that shows the new secret once with a copy button.

items.name: delete-account-01
items.title: Delete Account
items.description: An account deletion screen with an export link first, a list of what gets deleted, and a form that unlocks after you type your email and check each acknowledgement.

items.name: team-members-01
items.title: Team Members
items.description: A team members list whose row menu removes someone after a second click, and makes someone the owner after a dialog explains what changes.

items.name: file-manager-01
items.title: File Manager
items.description: A file list where selected files move to trash with an undo toast, a Trash tab restores them one at a time, and an Empty trash dialog lists what goes and asks you to type a phrase.

items.name: inbox-01
items.title: Inbox
items.description: A message list where archive and delete collapse the row in place with an Undo, and a reading pane whose toolbar archives on a second click and deletes on a hold.

items.name: agent-approval-01
items.title: Agent Approval
items.description: An agent turn with four tool calls waiting for approval, from a low-risk message that approves with undo to a critical delete that asks for the project name. Each call shows its tool, risk and arguments, then its result once it runs.

items.name: bulk-actions-01
items.title: Bulk Actions
items.description: An issue list with row checkboxes whose delete asks for more as the count grows: an undo window for one or two, a second click for a few, and the typed count for more.

items.name: scheduled-deletion-01
items.title: Scheduled Deletion
items.description: Workspace settings where Delete schedules the workspace for deletion after a 30-day grace period with a Keep banner, and a Trash list restores projects or deletes them forever on a hold.

items.name: reauth-01
items.title: Re-authentication
items.description: Billing settings that ask for a 6-digit code before changing the billing email or removing a card, show an inline error on a wrong code, and don't ask again for 2 hours. The demo verify accepts 123456.

items.name: settings-save-bar-01
items.title: Settings Save Bar
items.description: A team settings form where any edit brings up a save bar. Discard asks for a second click, and leaving the page with unsaved changes asks whether to save, discard or keep editing.

items.name: transfer-ownership-01
items.title: Transfer Ownership
items.description: Hand a project to another member. The dialog lists what changes for you, and it asks for the project name before transferring.

items.name: cancel-subscription-01
items.title: Cancel Subscription
items.description: A plan card whose cancel dialog lists what goes away and when, offers a cheaper plan instead, and cancels on a second click.
